propositions: Non-create operation plans (update, delete, probe, clean-label, repair-property, conflict handling) must execute as atomic postconditions in dependency order, preserving successful earlier operations and re-observing only remaining drift after partial failure within a single logical budget.

Dispositions must be normalized across auto-healed, success, deferred, permanent, commit-unknown, exhausted transient, and skipped outcomes with ticket, endpoint, tenant, provider, and global scope; commit_unknown outcomes are ticket-scoped, projected to deferred bucket, and replay-forbidden.

Endpoint-failure scoped fuse opens after three consecutive eligible exhausted logical outcomes (exhausted_transient or retryable_deferred) across at least two tickets on that endpoint; provider-scope fuse additionally requires outcomes spanning at least two distinct endpoints of the same provider; matching success resets consecutive counter state.

Physical attempts, recovered warnings, permanent failures, ticket-local 404s, opaque diagnostics (commit_unknown), and S2 defer reasons must be excluded from inferred fuse counters; only budget-cap exhausted dispositions are eligible for fuse increment.

When endpoint or provider fuse opens, remaining matching plans defer with explicit reason, scope, and retry_not_before metadata while independent scopes continue executing; exact applied/failed/deferred/skipped tallies and nonzero degraded-pass signaling must be preserved.
